props.text: New Article: The Billion-Dollar Assumption Behind Every AI Coding Agent

The AI coding industry in 2026 — Cursor at $1B ARR, Copilot at 4.7M subscribers, Claude Code at 1M+ weekly developers — is built on one premise: the AI writes code, a human reviews it. Every product, every benchmark, every deployment guide assumes someone is watching. MiroShark has been running without a reviewer for 204 days, filing 72 self-improvement PRs against its own logic, with zero open issues. The industry built a better pair programmer. One project asked what happens when the programmer does not need a pair.
